about: What the rules in generate.mjs can't see in cmangos.json, each checked on Wowhead Classic (the quest page and its players' comments). A kind here replaces the rules' kind for that quest; "none" leaves it off the list. generate.mjs refuses a review that only repeats the rules, and one for a quest cmangos.json no longer has.

434.why: Lescovar and Marzon walk to the garden and talk; the quest is to wait there, then fight them. The start script only walks and casts.

452.why: Waves of Pyrewood elites attack right away. The hook starts Faerleia's event.

1173.why: Mok'Morokk walks a few steps and turns on you: the quest is to beat him. The hook uses the escort code for his walk.

1249.why: Tapoke Jahn and his bodyguard fight you as he leaves the inn. The hook uses the escort code for his walk.

1651.why: Daphne walks home and three waves of Defias attack. The hook uses the escort code for her walk.

2845.why: Shay follows you and wanders off; the quest is to bring her home (Warcraft Wiki's escort quests). The hook sends her start event.

2904.why: Kernobee follows you out of Gnomeregan (Warcraft Wiki's escort quests). The hook sends his start event.

3463.why: Kalaran the Deceiver shows himself, talks and flies off along his path: a scene, no fight.

3525.why: Belnistrasz starts his ritual and waves attack until it ends. The hook uses the escort code for his walk.

4021.why: Kolkar waves attack Regthar's defenders right away. The hook starts his event.

4966.why: Galak assassins attack Kanati as soon as she starts. The hook uses the escort code for her walk.

5162.why: Haleh's Will throws you through the air, then the game carries you away (the start script casts it, then teleports).

7046.why: Celebras walks to his altar and starts the ritual you assist. The start script only walks.

8447.why: Remulos leads you to the shrine and Malfurion appears; the quest is to wait for the ritual. The start script summons Malfurion, friendly.

8730.why: Vaelastrasz starts the raid's five-hour timer to kill Nefarian. The hook sets the instance's timer.

8736.why: Remulos walks to the lake and Eranikus attacks Nighthaven: a raid fight. The hook uses the escort code for his walk.

1371.why: Warug's target dummy appears and blows itself up: no fight.

1482.why: Images of Jugkar and Azrethoc act out a scene: no fight.

2521.why: Kum'isha's sphere scene with a Draenei refugee: no fight.

3463.why: Kalaran the Deceiver appears and flies off: a scene, no fight.
